steps.en: PDF copies of the letters sent are available
steps.id: Salinan PDF letter yang dikirim tersedia
steps.why_en: OCMS only builds PDFs for advisory letters. Reminder and demand letters go out as data files.
steps.why_id: OCMS hanya membuat PDF untuk surat advisory. Surat reminder dan demand dikirim sebagai data file.

steps.en: The letter PDFs are uploaded to the customer portal
steps.id: PDF letter di-upload ke portal pelanggan
steps.why_en: No process sends the letter PDFs to the customer portal.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada proses yang mengirim PDF letter ke portal pelanggan.

steps.en: Only letters from the past X months, with X from a parameter
steps.id: Hanya letter X bulan terakhir, X dari parameter
steps.why_en: There is no month-count parameter for letters in the system.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada parameter jumlah bulan untuk letter di sistem.

steps.en: The user logs in to the customer portal
steps.why_en: A general login exists but only leads to the payment and furnish pages.
steps.why_id: Login umum ada, tetapi hanya mengarah ke halaman bayar dan furnish.

steps.en: The portal shows the list of letters sent to the user
steps.id: Portal menampilkan daftar letter milik user
steps.why_en: There is no page or function that lists letters on the portal.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada halaman atau fungsi untuk daftar letter di portal.

steps.en: The user can view and download a PDF copy of the letter
steps.id: User bisa lihat dan unduh salinan PDF letter
steps.why_en: The portal can only download payment receipts, not letters.
steps.why_id: Portal hanya bisa mengunduh struk pembayaran, bukan letter.
